title: Model override using ANTHROPIC_MODEL is not working.
body:
Exported ANTHROPIC_MODEL to Haiku 3.5 

printenv results in

```
ANTHROPIC_MODEL=anthropic.claude-3-5-haiku-20241022-v1:0
DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING=1
AWS_REGION=us-east-1
CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1
```

However, in AWS CW Bedrocks metrics, it is still using Sonnet 3.7. 

Even upon asking which model are you using 
It response

`I'm using claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0.`
author: Croskcool
